Callout.Name: Sudden Confusion
Callout.Message: Elderly person suddenly confused, carer concerned.

Script.Line: I was looking for the bus. I know this street. I do not know this street.
Something has not been right all evening.
Is it Wednesday? It cannot be Wednesday.

Callout.Patient: Who are you? Where is my daughter?

Lines.Approach: She was fine this morning and now she does not know the carer. That is new, and new is the point.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
